components.purpose: Top-of-page hero built specifically for A/B testing — its 'Control' heading plus nested 'Variants' grid let marketing configure and test two different headlines (with matching description/CTA/image) for the paid ad traffic, tied to an Experiment Key.

Displays a single selected testimonial (via its linked-content dropdown to one TestimonialItem) to build trust/social proof right after the headline — matches the request for 'a single testimonial' rather than the multi-item 'Testimonials' list component.

Closing contact/lead-capture form (heading, description, submit URL, success/error/loading messages) for visitors converting from the ad — fulfills the 'contact form' requirement at the bottom of the page.
